The Fedora runtime includes the libde265 decoder library from libde265 1.0.18-1.fc44 and the HEVC decoder plugin from libheif-freeworld 1.23.7-1.fc44. Both files are unmodified x86-64 Fedora 44 RPM Fusion builds. The matching source RPMs are in src. On Fedora with RPM build dependencies installed, use rpmbuild --rebuild on each source RPM to rebuild the libraries. The plugin links dynamically to libde265 and the system libheif. Their license texts are included under linux/notices. The app loads the private plugin only in its ImageMagick child process.
